info.description: berth's API, served by `berth serve`. Each endpoint is one of berth's operations, with the rules the command line has: an operation that changes something needs a caller that may write; one that restarts a container needs a caller that may restart, and the org's name again as `confirm`. Secret values are never returned. Errors are berth.error/v1 documents.

post.description: Runs one of berth's sign-in commands on a pseudo-terminal, as server-sent events: `session` (its id), `output` (what it prints, as text) and `exit` (its exit code). What it prints is a terminal's: it has escape sequences, and for a sign-in it can show the org's new token, as the command line does. It ends with the command, or when the caller goes away. It is not a shell.
